messages:
anya: Heads-up — tomorrow 02:00 UTC change window for the runtime+console+router rollout. Who's owning the pin/ownership handshake for the API header-swap dependency? We need clear rollback criteria before I sign off.
kevin: I can take ownership of the runtime side. I'll watch throughput and KV eviction metrics during the window.
jason: Router team will handle header translation pin. Will be online for the whole window. We need deploy-bot to sequence the header swap after runtime is green.
maria: Console: we'll be behind a feature flag; can we keep a quick-unpin path? If API clients break we should be able to revert console changes independently.
deploy-bot: Deploy plan created: rollout/6612345678. Steps: 1) runtime canary (5%) 2) router header-swap (canary) 3) console flag ramp 4) traffic shift. Use /deploy followups.
anya: OK. Documenting rollback triggers here: > - runtime p99 latency > 200ms over 5m or error rate spike > 1% 

Those are hard cut triggers for immediate rollback to prior pinned variant.
kevin: Agree. Adding cost/throughput guard: GPU memory OOMs or KV cache thrash -> immediate rollback. I'll post alerts in the runbook.
jason: For router: if 4xxs to API increase > 0.5% vs baseline over 3m, revert header-swap and route to legacy.
maria: Console: if UI errors show more than 0.3% or critical telemetry fails, disable flag and re-route admin traffic to fallback.
anya: Who's giving the final go/no-go at T-15? Need single owner to call rollback if teams don't respond.
sre-oncall: I'll be the primary signal owner and will call rollback on infra signals (OOMs, cross-service cascade). Recommend product/eng lead for user-impact decisions.
kevin: I'll be primary for runtime metrics, +1 to SRE on infra signals.
jason: Router +1. Will also keep a pinned variant ready: router:v2-20260323-pin.
maria: Console has a pinned release: console:pin-20260323. We'll keep it decoupled.
anya: Nice. Small ops note: deploy-bot runbook snippet to include (copy this into release notes):
```
sequence:
  - runtime: canary=5% wait=10m
  - router: canary=10% wait=5m
  - console: flag-ramp=50% wait=10m
  - traffic-shift: 100%
rollback_triggers:
  - runtime_p99_ms: 200
  - runtime_error_rate_pct: 1
  - router_4xx_delta_pct: 0.5
  - console_ui_error_pct: 0.3
owners:
  runtime: kevin
  router: jason
  console: maria
  signal_owner: sre-oncall
```
deploy-bot: Added runbook to rollout/6612345678 and attached the above snippet to the release notes. Tagging: @kevin @jason @maria @sre-oncall.
anya: Thanks — I updated the release notes with the pinned variant names and rollback contacts. Everyone please add any test prompts/traffic patterns to the release page so we can run synthetic checks during canary.
kevin: Will push a small smoke test that hits long-sequence runtime paths and KV hot prefixes.
jason: Router will run header-compat matrix. If any schema mismatch appears, we'll auto-fail the router step.
maria: Console will withhold the admin UI feature behind the flag until 90 minutes post-rollout if stable.
sre-oncall: I'll post heartbeat pings every 5m during the window and escalate to oncall pager at first infra trigger.
anya: Great. Final: T-15 decision is me for product/impact, SRE for infra. If both green, deploy-bot proceeds. If either calls fail, we halt and pin back. :thumbsup:
